newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean Imacec growth index up 6.5 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Chilean Imacec growth index up 6.5 pct in April.

text.p: The Chilean economy grew 6.5 percent in April as measured by the Imacec index over the same month last year, the Central Bank reported.

It was the strongest monthly growth rate so far this year and pointed to brisker growth in the economy after a sluggish first quarter, in which the Imacec posted a 3.9 percent rise. But the April rate was still below the 8.8 percent growth rate in April last year.
Growth in the first quarter was weighed down by tight Central Bank interest rates, which were relaxed in May, and severe drought in central Chile, which ended in late May with the arrival of rain.
The Central Bank was due to release details on the figures later.
